name: ささはら　くぐい
description: 新卒でゲーム会社のデザイナーになりました。2D/3D

works.body:
Mr. Sasahara Kugen.
Thank you for your help.
I'm Runa Nekomiya.
I would like to contact you again to request an illustration.

This time, I would like you to draw an illustration of Halloween.
I would like you to draw a witch with a pumpkin bag and some candies.
I will leave all the size and composition to you.

Also, I would like to use it as a thumbnail for YouTube and Twitter, so I would appreciate it if you could provide me with a transparent version.

Thank you very much for your time.

Hello, my name is Jun Kagami.

I'd like to ask you to draw a picture of me, vtuber Jun Kagami.
I'll leave the composition to you.

Here is my reference image.
Reference image(https://twitter.com/jun_xxxx0222/status/1376541008578576391)

I would like to introduce this image on SNS, and use it for SNS header, icon, thumbnail, etc. If possible, background transparency difference would be helpful.

Thank you very much for your cooperation.

Hello.
My name is YORK.
I would like to request a bust up picture.
The purpose is to use it as a thumbnail for YouTube commentary videos and as a standing picture. (I'm also thinking of using Live2D in the future)

The image is of a boy with a Kansai dialect and a bit of a flirtatious feeling. The pose is a standing picture, so please stand on a stick.

Hello again, my name is Runa Nekomiya.
I would like to contact you to request an illustration.

I'd like you to draw a picture of a swimsuit for my illustration.
The color of the swimsuit is mainly white, but I would be happy if you could mix in some pastel light pink.
I'd like you to draw an off-the-shoulder swimsuit with frills and lace.


For the composition, I'd like the body to be lying on its side, and I'd be happy if the legs were bent, although either side is fine.
Also, the size and design are all up to Mr. Kugen Sasahara.

We would also like to use it as a thumbnail for YouTube and Twitter, so we would appreciate it if you could provide us with a transparent version.

This is my first time using Skeb, so I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and thank you for your patience.
